Title: Info
Text:
Want to enhance your database scalability and use all your performances available with your multi-cores machines?

With 4D v16, we have extended the list of thread-safe commands in order to enhance your performances with preemptive processes.

Now all:
- XML DOM,
- XML SAX
- and XML commands
are thread safe and can be used in preemptive mode.

A little reminder: all thread safe commands are now marked in doc center with this icon:

Title: Test
Text:
There is a routine comparing XML files, either in preemptive or in cooperative mode. You can modify the number of files to compare and the number of workers you will create for the routine.

The time that the routine takes in preemptive mode is noticeably less in compiled mode only. The optimal number of workers depends on the number of cores your machine has. The more you have, the greater the difference is between preemptive and cooperative mode for the whole comparison.
